entries.02334004740b2234: This is the core business of the group, carried out by consolidated subsidiaries Kiraboshi Bank, Ltd. and UI Bank Co., Ltd. Kiraboshi Bank, with Tokyo and the northeastern part of Kanagawa Prefecture as its main operating area, conducts deposit, lending, trading securities, investment securities, domestic exchange, foreign exchange and trust business, among others. UI Bank, a digital bank, conducts deposit, lending and domestic exchange business, among others, through an app. Ordinary income from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥162,069 million.

entries.990b86ccbd4e5b3a: Centered on Kiraboshi Bank, which was born from the merger of Tokyo Tomin Bank, Yachiyo Bank and Shin-ginko Tokyo, the company combines face-to-face banking operations with the digital services of UI Bank, which provides services through an app. The company has group companies covering leasing, securities, consulting, and credit management and collection, and has a structure that enables it to respond to customers' challenges as one group, including support for business succession and overseas expansion.
entries.a757beef79ac51d3: Under its management philosophy, 'As a financial group for small and medium-sized enterprises and individual customers in the Tokyo metropolitan area, we contribute to the development of the local community through comprehensive financial services', and under its purpose, 'Let's Create TOKYO Together', the company is working on its medium-term management plan (three-year plan period) that started in fiscal 2024. Its vision for the future is 'a comprehensive service business strong in finance', and it is advancing measures including strengthening earnings capacity, reviewing its revenue structure, and expanding fee-based business through the provision of high-quality consulting functions.
